subject: POC scope & model shortlist — ShopWell multilingual checkout assistant
messages:
From: Ana Ramirez <ana.ramirez@shopwell.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-29T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Quick recap + POC asks from today

Thanks for the time today — quick recap from our side and a few asks so we can scope the POC.

Highlights from the call:
- Use case: multilingual checkout assistant (product search + cart support + simple refunds). Primary channels: web chat widget, mobile app.
- Expected volume: ~20k queries/day, peak 500 qps sustained for short bursts.
- Latency target: p95 < 600ms for user-facing responses.
- Data: no customer PII in initial tests; we will sanitize logs but need to confirm retention policy.

ShopWell asks for the POC:
1) 6-week trial with measurable acceptance criteria (see below).
2) Evidence of SOC2 controls and audit logs for the trial environment (attach security reqs).
3) Multilingual coverage: Spanish, French, Portuguese (priority order).
4) Demo of end-to-end latency with real-ish payloads.
5) Clear ownership and weekly checkpoints.

Success criteria proposed by ShopWell:
- Intent/resolve accuracy >= 85% on annotated sample set.
- Auto-resolution rate that reduces agent handoffs by >= 30%.
- p95 latency < 600ms in trial infra (during normal load).

Attached: ShopWell_Security_Reqs.pdf with questionnaire we referenced.

Availability for kickoff: next Monday (2028-08-05) morning PT would work for our team.

Thanks,
Ana Ramirez
Head of Product Operations
ShopWell
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Ana Ramirez <ana.ramirez@shopwell.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-29T18:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + POC asks from today

Ana — thanks for the clear recap, and great to meet the ShopWell team. Below is a pragmatic POC plan and an initial model shortlist for us to validate during the trial. Please let us know which items are must-have vs nice-to-have and confirm kickoff timing.

Proposed POC (6 weeks) — high level
- Week 0 (pre-kick): access, security review, dataset transfer (anonymized sample), SSO + firewall rules.
- Week 1: kickoff, end-to-end integration (chat widget -> Redwood API), baseline logging.
- Week 2: baseline eval vs annotated sample, tune prompts & routing.
- Week 3–4: iterate on accuracy & fallbacks, run load tests for peak hour behavior.
- Week 5: acceptance test (intent accuracy, latency, cost estimate).
- Week 6: wrap, decision and handoff runbook.

Model shortlist (initial recommendation)
- Primary (fast/low-latency): Mistral-7B-instruct (instruction-tuned) — chosen for inference throughput and instruction-following.
- Fallback (higher-capacity for edge cases): Llama-2-13B (4-bit quant) — better on long-context product disambiguation.
- Multilingual strategy: Mistral-multiling-7B for Spanish/French; for Portuguese we can route through a lightweight translation service (open-translate) before inference to keep latency predictable.

Key engineering knobs we'll instrument:
- Prefix caching for common checkout prompts.
- Continuous batching with strict latency SLOs.
- Token-level cost tracking per route/model.

Acceptance metrics (aligned to your list)
- Intent accuracy (annotated set): >= 85% to pass.
- Auto-resolution rate: >= 30% improvement.
- Latency: p95 < 600ms under normal load; collect p95 under simulated peak.

Ownership
- Trial lead / customer-facing: Marissa Cole (marissa@redwood.ai)
- Infra / performance: Ben Carter (ben@redwood.ai)
- Eval harness & data: Jordan Blake (jordan@redwood.ai)

Immediate asks from ShopWell to unblock the Week 0 tasks:
- SSO admin contact + allowed IP ranges for the trial.
- Anonymized sample dataset (1000 queries across three languages).
- Confirmation that security questionnaire should be routed to your security contact (if different from you).

I attached a short trial SOW draft link — we can iterate on scope/cost once you confirm scope.

If Monday 8/5 morning PT works, we can schedule a 45-minute kickoff.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: Ana Ramirez <ana.ramirez@shopwell.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-30T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + POC asks from today

Thanks Vivek — this looks good. A few tweaks:
- Please include a fallback path that uses open-translate for Portuguese rather than immediate model routing — we have legacy translation assets we prefer to reuse.
- For peak hour tests, can you provide a short estimate for reserved (dedicated) capacity vs hosted bursts? We want to understand cost/latency tradeoffs.
- Confirmed: kickoff Monday 8/5 10:00 AM PT works for our team (I'll share calendar invite).
- We will deliver the anonymized 1k sample by Friday 8/2.

Can you also include a cost estimate for the 6-week trial (ballpark) so procurement has a number to budget? Not final, just a working figure.

Appreciate it — Ana
From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-30T12:02:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: ShopWell POC — model/config notes + next steps

Team — thread summary and proposed config details for the trial. Copying points to action items.

Model/config proposals
- Mistral-7B-instruct as primary. Run it on Redwood Dedicated pool with autoscale up to 6 instances during load tests to ensure p95 headroom.
- Llama-2-13B (4-bit quant) as fallback for low-confidence responses; enable synchronous fallback but cap calls to avoid cost spikes.
- Multilingual: use Mistral-multiling-7B for Spanish/French. For Portuguese, follow Ana's ask: wire up open-translate microservice (we'll deploy as an internal function) then feed back to Mistral-7B to keep response flavor consistent.

Performance knobs
- Aggressive prefix/KV cache for search/cart intents.
- Dynamic batching target to hit 75ms average token latency while keeping p95 under 600ms.
- Instrument token-level breakdown; Jordan to add eval hooks to trace token cost per route.

Security/compliance
- Ben: start SOC2 evidence checklist review with ShopWell_Security_Reqs.pdf. We'll provide audit-log exports for trial.

Cost & Sizing (ballpark for 6-week trial)
- Hosted (shared): ~$9k — includes baseline throughput and small burst cushion.
- Dedicated (reserved minimal pool for peak): ~$24k — better p95 headroom, predictable cost.
- Note: numbers include egress and token estimates based on 20k q/day, 80 tokens/response average. We'll refine post-integration.

Action items
- Jordan: draft eval harness + leaderboard for week2 (annotated accuracy, intent confusion matrix). Due 2028-08-03.
- Ben: SOC2 checklist owner + estimated time to provide logs. Ping ShopWell security contact by EOD.
- Vivek: confirm kickoff invite + share SOW stub.

Attachment: Trial_SOW_v1.pdf (draft) — please review before sending to Ana.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Ana Ramirez <ana.ramirez@shopwell.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-08-01T11:24:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed: ShopWell POC kickoff + owners, next steps

Ana — thanks, confirmed for Monday 8/5 10:00 AM PT. Calendar invite received. A few housekeeping notes before kickoff:

3) Trial SOW + cost ballpark
- Attached: Trial_SOW_v1.pdf (draft).

4) Preliminary runbook highlights

  - Annotated accuracy report (Jordan)
  - Latency sweep at 250/500/1000 qps (Ben)

Related links: HubSpot deal HSPOT-123456, shared docs: https://redwood.gdrive/drive/folders/1a2b3c/ShopWell-POC

If anything changes before kickoff, reply here and we'll adjust. Looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
